summary: Ukrainian forces report multiple drone and missile attacks across frontlines, including strikes on Black Sea infrastructure and military targets. Russia's use of A-50U aircraft to intercept Ukrainian Flamingo missiles has disrupted Ukrainian strikes on Russian industrial sites. Ukrainian military updates highlight ongoing combat in Sumy, Belgorod, and Zaporozhye regions.

Ukrainian troops repel Russian counterattacks near Sadki village in Sumy (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515)
Drone strikes damage infrastructure in 16 LNR municipalities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32515)

threat_assessment: Russia's deployment of A-50U aircraft significantly reduces Ukrainian Flamingo missile effectiveness, potentially shifting strategic advantage. Continued Black Sea attacks on energy infrastructure could escalate economic warfare. Ukraine's Patriot missile shortages may limit counteroffensive capabilities.
regional_response: EU prepares largest sanctions package against Russia since 2022, targeting energy and military sectors. Ukraine appeals for international support to replenish missile stocks. Russia accelerates Shahed drone production to counter Ukrainian air defenses.
intelligence_notes: Russia's A-50U deployment suggests increased focus on early-warning systems. Ukraine's Patriot missile shortages highlight vulnerabilities in air defense. Black Sea attacks indicate Russia's targeting of energy infrastructure as a strategic priority.
